Manifest.Name: 直接替换 / Quick Replace
Manifest.Author: w7lau
Manifest.Description: 把新滤芯拖到水壶上，或把新电池拖到电器上，直接换下旧的。旧件放回原来的物品栏，放不下就不换。 把电池拖到充电器本体上：有空位先放入。放不下时，没充满的电池优先换出已满电的，让出位置继续充电；有多块满电电池时，取电量最多的一块。没有合适的满电电池，或拖入的电池已满时，才按剩余电量换出比手里电量更多的一块。打开充电器后，仍可拖到指定电池上交换，或拖到空格里放入。 Drag a new filter or battery onto a device to replace the old one. The old item returns to the source inventory; nothing is swapped if it cannot fit. Drop a battery onto the charger itself to fill empty space first. If there is no room, a battery that needs charging takes the place of a fully charged one, choosing the most energy among fully charged batteries. If none is eligible, or the incoming battery is already full, take a battery only if it has more remaining energy. Inside the open charger, drop onto a specific battery to swap with it, or onto empty space to place it there.
